content: संयत {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Restrained, curbed, subdued. .²2 Tied up, bound together. .²3 Fettered. .²4 Captive, imprisoned, a prisoner; न संयतस्तस्य बभूव रक्षितुः <ls>R. 3. 20</ls>. .²4 Ready. .²5 Arranged; see यम् with सम्. .{@-तः@} .²1 One who has restrained his passions, an ascetic. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva.
